Carbon Limits AS (2016). Zero emission technologies for pneumatic controllers in the USA: Applicability and cost effectiveness. Version 2.0, finalized 1 August 2016. Prepared for Clean Air Task Force (CATF); project leader Stephanie Saunier, with Hesam Darani and Anders Pederstad. Oslo: Carbon Limits AS. https://www.carbonlimits.no/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Report_FINAL.pdf

Region: USA (oil and gas production sites and compressor stations). Page numbers are the printed footer numbers, which equal PDF pages. Loaded: per-device emission factors of gas-driven controllers (continuous-bleed retrofit 14.43, low-bleed new 1.39, intermittent 4.43, chemical pump 13.3, ESD 0.41 scfh whole gas) and baseline device costs; electronic controller and electric pump unit equipment costs; the two worked examples (solar electronic controllers at a 4-controller off-grid site: retrofit CAPEX 21,240 USD and 751 USD/t CH4, new 847; instrument air at a 20-controller grid site: retrofit CAPEX 120,000 USD and 972 USD/t CH4, new 886); grid-electric abatement costs from the sensitivity tables (611 retrofit, 548 new); CAPEX ranges for 21-40-controller instrument air sites and for instrument air projects in general; self-contained controller cost bound. Other-values: component costs (panels, batteries, compressor packages by HP), sizing rules, sensitivity results, social cost of methane, derived t CH4/yr per device (not printed). Not loaded: chart values (Figures 2-5, 8-12), the per-configuration lists of not-cost-effective sites (Tables 22-24), most summary thresholds (Table 16). Traps: (1) no price year printed; costs treated as 2016 USD (quotes March-April 2016; social cost converted to 2016 USD). (2) Table 6 rounds EFs (14.4, 4.4) that Tables 13 and 17 give as 14.43 and 4.43. (3) Battery cost 500 USD in Table 3 but 400 in Tables 8 and 17. (4) Abatement cost is NPV of net cost divided by discounted CH4 avoided (not EPA annualised); 7% real, gas at 2 USD/Mscf, VOC benefits excluded. (5) Emission factors are whole-gas volumes, not CH4. (6) Text says 20 of 2032 configurations exceed the social cost for electric controllers, Table 11 sums to 19; summary says 2008 of 2032 are below it. (7) Tables 20 and 21 titles misprinted (retrofit site with 4 controllers). SUPERSESSION: the 2021 update (carbon-limits_2021_001) is an annex-update that supersedes this report for electronic controller equipment, installation and abatement costs and adds solar-powered instrument air; it keeps this report's grid instrument air costs, baseline gas-driven device costs and emission factors unchanged, so those remain sourced here.
